scope.summary: Implement custom tape measures on avatar and garment (CG-21, MD Avatar/3D-Garment Tape Measures): typed linear, circumference, and surface tapes authored on avatar or garment meshes, recomputed per frame/drape, plus a measure_garment MCP tool returning named measurement rows - the LLM fit-verification surface per 13.7 §7.1 + 13.13.
acceptance_criteria: TapeMeasure records (kind linear|circumference|surface; anchor points as mesh barycentric refs; target avatar|garment) persisted (TPM- ids) and recomputed against current pose/drape state.
measure_garment / measure_avatar MCP tools return named tape values in cm plus the 25 standard measurements; deltas vs previous sim run included for fit iteration.
Tapes render as viewport overlays (reuse MT-245 debug overlay path) with stable author_ids; Argus can read values via typed route.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-469 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: Numeric fit verification is how a model proves a garment fits without eyeballing renders; without tapes the self-correction loop regresses to screenshot guessing.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Model and agent operation

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
